# Internet MCP

> Universal Live Browser MCP Server. Execute scripts in open tabs, inspect DOM data, list, group, close, and deduplicate browser tabs across Chrome, Firefox, and all windows from any MCP client — Claude Desktop, VS Code/Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Continue, Cline, Hermes, and others.

Two components: a **browser extension** (built with [WXT](https://wxt.dev) as one source tree targeting Chrome MV3 and Firefox MV2) that proxies `browser.tabs`, `browser.tabGroups`, and `browser.scripting` operations, and a **Node.js MCP host** that runs over stdio and communicates with extensions over WebSocket port 9876. Multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox) and multiple windows connect simultaneously without collisions. No daemon, no cloud dependency — everything runs locally on loopback.

Important notes:
- Supports concurrent multi-browser sessions: Chrome with 100 tabs + Firefox with multiple windows can run simultaneously. Tabs are identified with optional browser prefixes (e.g. `chrome:12` or `firefox:34`).
- Supports running JavaScript directly in browser tabs via `execute_script` (useful for pulling images, links, tables, or dynamic DOM elements).
- Multiple MCP clients can share the same browsers. Host processes self-organize with an owner/follower pattern: one binds port 9876, the rest proxy through it. On owner death, followers re-elect automatically.
- Requires Chrome (or any Chromium browser) or Firefox, Node >= 18, and an available loopback port 9876.
- The extension auto-reconnects via `browser.alarms` every 30 seconds (required by MV3 idle behaviour).
- Created by jamubc.

## Install

- [Browser Extension](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/tree/main/extension): Build with WXT (`cd extension && npm install && npm run build` for Chrome, `npm run build:firefox` for Firefox), then load the unpacked build from `.output/chrome-mv3/` (`chrome://extensions`, Developer mode, "Load unpacked") or `.output/firefox-mv2/` (`about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox`, "Load Temporary Add-on…").
- [MCP Host via npx](https://www.npmjs.com/package/internet-mcp-host): Run `npx -y internet-mcp-host` — no global install needed (aliased to `2manytabs-mcp-host`).
- [Claude Code](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp): `claude mcp add internet-mcp -- npx -y internet-mcp-host`
- [Claude Desktop](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp): Add to `claude_desktop_config.json` with command `npx` and args `["-y", "internet-mcp-host"]`.
- [VS Code / Copilot Chat](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/customization/mcp-servers): Add to `.vscode/mcp.json` with the same command/args block.
- [Cursor](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp): Add to `.cursor/mcp.json` or Settings → MCP.
- [Windsurf](https://windsurf.com/university/general-education/intro-to-mcp): Add to `mcp_config.json` or Settings → Cascade → MCP.
- [Continue](https://docs.continue.dev/customize/mcp-tools): Add to `.continue/config.json` or `.continue/mcpServers/`.
- [Cline](https://docs.cline.bot/mcp/mcp-overview): Add via the MCP Servers panel.
- [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/all-in-aigen/hermes): `hermes mcp add internet-mcp --command "npx -y internet-mcp-host"`
- Any stdio MCP client: Point it at `npx -y internet-mcp-host`.

## Tools

- [list_tabs](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/list-tabs.tool.js): Read open tabs across Chrome and Firefox. Returns a domain histogram with proportional bars plus a per-domain tab listing showing titles, pinned (📌), audible (🔊), and browser flags. Accepts `query`, `group_by`, `duplicates_only`, and `browser` filter. Read-only.
- [execute_script](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/execute-script.tool.js): Execute JavaScript in an open tab and return serialized results. Accepts `tab_id` (numeric or composite `chrome:12`), `script` (JS string expression), `world` (`ISOLATED` or `MAIN`), and `browser` hint.
- [close_tabs](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/close-tabs.tool.js): Close tabs across connected browsers by `tab_ids` (numbers or composite IDs), `match`, or `duplicates: true`. Supports `dry_run: true` and `browser` filter.
- [open_tabs](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/open-tabs.tool.js): Open new tabs in the browser given an array of `urls` and optional target `browser`.
- [list_tab_groups](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/list-tab-groups.tool.js): List all existing native Chrome Tab Groups in the current browser session. Returns IDs, titles, colors, collapsed states, and parent window IDs.
- [group_tabs](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/group-tabs.tool.js): Group open Chrome tabs into native Chrome Tab Groups. Required: `tab_ids`. Optional: `group_id`, `title`, `color`.
- [ungroup_tabs](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/ungroup-tabs.tool.js): Remove one or more open Chrome tabs from their current native Tab Groups. Required: `tab_ids`.
- [update_tab_group](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/update-tab-group.tool.js): Update properties of an existing native Chrome Tab Group. Required: `group_id`. Optional: `title`, `color`, `collapsed`.
- [activate_tab](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/activate-tab.tool.js): Bring a specific browser tab to the foreground and focus its window. Accepts `tab_id` and optional `browser`.
- [update_tab](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/update-tab.tool.js): Modify properties of an open browser tab (`url`, `pinned`, `muted`). Accepts `tab_id` and optional `browser`.
- [get_tab_text](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/tools/get-tab-text.tool.js): Extract the plain body text of a loaded browser tab via `scripting`. Required: `tab_id`.

## Architecture

- [Extension bridge](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/bridge.js): Multi-browser WebSocket bridge implementing client registry and owner/follower self-organization. Merges tabs from multiple browsers and routes tab-specific actions by ID or composite address.
- [Extension background entrypoint](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/extension/entrypoints/background.js): WXT `defineBackground()` entrypoint. Identifies browser on connection and dispatches browser operations.
- [Tab operations](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/extension/lib/tab-ops.js): Proxies `browser.tabs`, `browser.tabGroups`, and `browser.scripting` (including `executeScript`).
- [Host entry point](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/host.js): MCP server bootstrap using `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`. Registers tools from the `tools/` registry and connects over stdio.

## Tab helpers

- [tabs.js](https://github.com/jamubc/2manytabs-mcp/blob/main/native-host/lib/tabs.js): Pure helper functions shared by the read/filter tools — `domainOf`, `matchesQuery`, `findDuplicateIds`, `domainHistogram`, `groupByDomain`, `groupByWindow`, `compact`. Side-effect-free; all selection and grouping logic lives here so the extension stays focused on Chrome API calls.

## Optional

- [MCP TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk): The `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` (^1.29.0) used for tool registration, JSON Schema generation from Zod schemas, and stdio transport.
- [Zod](https://zod.dev): Runtime schema validation library (^4.4.3) used for tool input parsing.
